summary: Verified code-review cleanup: localStorage removal, cookie-only auth, logout warn-on-error, stable composite keys in Matches, eslint-disable comments. All 6 requested checks pass. Backend auth uses httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None cookies as expected; frontend uses axios withCredentials:true only. No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/.env sets CORS_ORIGINS="*" while CORSMiddleware uses allow_credentials=True. Current preview URL is same-origin so cookies work via the ingress, but if the app is ever served from a different origin, browsers will reject the response because wildcard origins are incompatible with credentials. Recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit frontend URL (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host) before any cross-origin deployment.

GET /api/matches, /api/seasons, /api/players, /api/stats/* are intentionally public (no Depends(get_current_user)). This is consistent with current UI (read-only pages render for anonymous users via API), but the review-request wording implied /matches should be protected. If authors want full-protected reads, add get_current_user as a dependency on those GETs. UI already redirects to /login when /auth/me 401s, so UX is correct either way.
